app.description: App to attach or switch to: display name, package, bundle id, or the simulator name it runs on. Matches running apps and already-attached ones.

vmUri.description: VM service URI, e.g. ws://127.0.0.1:1234/abc=/ws. Omit to auto-discover the running app.

platform.description: ios | android. Omit to derive from the VM.

mode.description: flutter | device | auto (default). device = drive the sim with no Flutter app.

device.description: iOS simulator UDID, Android serial or AVD name (booted when not running). Omit to use the device the app runs on. A device from the "no app running" list starts its app there.

launch.description: Flutter project folder to build and run, or an installed app id (bundle id or package) to reopen in seconds without a rebuild.

iosBridgePath.description: Path to compiled `glint-iossim` binary. iOS only.

camera.description: webcam: when attach boots an AVD by name, its front camera is the Mac camera (the built-in one, not a Continuity iPhone); the back keeps the AVD's own. macOS must allow the emulator to use the camera.

iosBackend.description: bridge (default) | xctest. xctest drives the simulator through glint's XCUITest runner, built once per Xcode. iOS, Flutter mode.

input.description: auto | app | device: where gestures go. app = inside the Flutter app; device = real touches (system prompts, keyboards, other apps too); auto = app first, device for the rest. Default auto. Replies say which in data.input.

iosInput.description: auto (default) | dtuhid | indigo: the simulator's real-touch transport; auto picks dtuhid where Xcode ships it.

signingTeam.description: Apple team id to sign a physical-iPhone build with, when attach launch: should not choose. iOS phones only.

androidInput.description: auto (default) | server | adb. server = glint's resident input server. Android only.

returnScene.description: Include the first get_scene render. Default false.

dryRun.description: List attachable apps + devices without attaching. Default false.

awaitSettle.description: Wait until the UI settles before returning. Default false.

op.description: status (default) | appearance | openurl | screenshot | privacy | biometric | network (physical iPhone: value list | off | <profile>)

udid.description: Target simulator UDID. Defaults to the attached device.

inline.description: op=screenshot: also return the image as image content, so no separate read is needed. Default false, true with glintId, region or apps.

maxSize.description: op=screenshot inline: longest side in pixels of the image sent (0 = full size); with apps, each device's height. Default: 720 for crops and side by side, else the screenshotMaxSize config (1024).

glintId.description: screenshot: crop to this widget, with a little margin. Sent inline, small.

region.description: screenshot: crop to {top, bottom, left, right}, fractions 0-1 of the screen (missing sides default to the edges). Sent inline, small.

apps.description: screenshot: several attached apps (name, package or device) in one image, side by side, left to right in this order.

waitFor.description: screenshot: first wait (up to 15 s) until the app (the first of apps) shows this text.

latest.description: screenshot only: return the newest background capture (taken when the app left the foreground) instead of taking a new one. Default false.

action.description: privacy: grant | revoke | reset. biometric: enrol | unenrol | match | nomatch (match/nomatch answer a Face ID / Touch ID prompt that is showing).

service.description: privacy: a simctl service: photos | microphone | location | location-always | contacts | notifications | … On Android also camera, phone, sms, screen-capture (the MediaProjection app op) and all.

bundleId.description: privacy: target app bundle id or Android package (grant/revoke). Default on Android: the attached app.

device.description: Device id. Defaults to the attached device.

force.description: Terminate an appId this session did not attach. Default false.

restart.description: Hot restart instead of hot reload. Default false.

op.description: seed | files | inspect | pick | permission | listen | mic | event | camera

stop.description: listen: end the recording and report it. mic: stop feeding and report what was fed.

setup.description: camera: true lets glint feed the AVD cameras (one emulator restart), false restores them.

value.description: event rotate: portrait | landscape | reversePortrait | reverseLandscape | auto. light: lux. proximity: near | far.

number.description: event call, endCall, sms: the caller. Default 5551234.

action.description: permission: grant | deny | reset (ask again) | limited (photos, Android 14+).

device.description: Simulator UDID or adb serial. Default: the attached device.

kind.description: seed: photo | video | audio. Default: from source, else video. event: rotate | light | proximity | call | endCall | sms.

source.description: seed: a host file path, or testcard | speech | tone. Default: testcard (tone for audio). camera: an image or video path, or testcard. mic: tone (default), speech, or a host audio file.

name.description: seed: asset name (also the file name). clear:true with name removes just that one. pick: a seeded asset to choose.

index.description: pick: position in the picker, 0 = newest. Default 0.

count.description: seed testcard photo: how many photos. Default 1.

clear.description: seed: remove what glint seeded on this device, nothing else. Android only.

durationSec.description: testcard video or tone: seconds. Default 6. mic: how long the feed runs, up to 600. Default 60.

fps.description: testcard video: frames per second. Default 30.

text.description: speech: what to say. event sms: the message.

since.description: files: lastAction (since the last tap, type, swipe ...) or an ISO time.

glob.description: files: e.g. *.mp4 (matches the file name, or the path when it has a /).

limit.description: files: cap on the list. Default 50, max 200.

pull.description: files: copy path to the host and return the host path.

path.description: files pull / inspect: a host path, or a path from files.

appId.description: files, permission: bundle id or package. Default: the attached app.

frames.description: inspect: times to return as images, seconds or start | middle | end (max 6).

probe.description: inspect: false leaves out the metadata and loudness lines. Default true.

maxSize.description: inspect: longest side of returned frames (0 = full). Default: screenshotMaxSize.

op.description: set | get | clear | route | pause | resume | stop | seek | wait | permission | services | answer

device.description: Simulator UDID, iPhone UDID or emulator serial. Default: the attached device.

heading.description: set: compass heading in degrees (Android only).

points.description: route: waypoints as "lat,lng" strings, in order.

file.description: route: a host GPX or KML file.

polyline.description: route: a Google encoded polyline, as directions APIs return.

polylineId.description: route: drive a polyline the attached app draws on its Google map, by the id get_scene lists.

speedKmh.description: route: travel speed. Default 30. set: the reported speed (Android only).

durationSec.description: route: travel the whole route in this many seconds instead of at speedKmh.

maxSpeedKmh.description: route: drive like a person: cruise wanders between speedKmh and this, accelerating and braking smoothly, slowing for turns and stopping at the end.

slowForTurns.description: route with maxSpeedKmh: brake before bends. Default true.

intervalMs.description: route: time between fixes. Default 1000; at least 500 on the iOS simulator, 2000 on an iPhone.

loop.description: route: start over at the end instead of stopping.

jitterM.description: route: GPS noise, about this many meters. Default 0.

dropout.description: route: share of fixes lost, 0 to 1. Default 0.

progress.description: seek, or route start: 0 to 1 along the route.

value.description: permission: whileUsing | always | approximate | deny | reset. services: on | off.

choice.description: answer: whileUsing | once | deny | always | keepWhileUsing.

precise.description: answer: pick precise (true) or approximate (false) location first, where the prompt offers it.

appId.description: permission: bundle id or package. Default: the attached app.

until.description: wait: arrived | progress | waypoint | near (with progress, waypoint, or at and withinM). Default arrived; omit with text alone to wait for the app.

withinM.description: wait until:near: meters from at. Default 50.

text.description: wait: text the attached app must also show (case-insensitive), e.g. "Driver arrived".

timeoutSec.description: wait: give up after this long. Default 120, max 600.

marker.description: tap: the marker id to tap. pan: the marker to center.

dx.description: pan: move the map content this many logical points right (negative: left).

dy.description: pan: move the map content this many logical points down (negative: up).

index.description: Which map when the screen has several, 0 = first. Default 0.

device.description: Device id. Defaults to the attached device.

all.description: Shut down every booted device. Default false.

force.description: Also shut down devices this session never used. Default false.

glintId.description: Only this node and its descendants. Use to drill into one container or list instead of re-reading the whole screen.

depth.description: With glintId: levels below it to include (0 = the node only). Default: all, up to the renderer's cap.

text.description: Visible text of the target instead of glintId, matched as tap does.
Visible text of the target instead of glintId: a button label or text, exact match first, then contains. Dialogs are searched first. Several matches fail with the candidates.

x.description: Raw x coordinate (with y). Device mode: screenshot pixels; flutter mode: logical points. Bypasses glintId.

sequence.description: Several taps in one call, fired back to back: [{glintId}|{x,y}, …], up to 50. For PIN pads, OTP keypads, amounts, repeated backspace. glintIds resolve from one scene read before the first tap; changed is read once at the end.

intervalMs.description: Pause between sequence taps, 0-2000 ms. Default 120.

refuseNotHittable.description: true refuses any target that may not be hittable, false never refuses (errorKind=notHittable). Default: refuse only when Flutter's hit test shows the tap would land on another widget.

awaitReady.description: Wait until the target is on screen and hittable, then act. Default false.

returnScene.description: Settle, then report changed and changeCategory. Default true.

detail.description: Include geometry (painted, hittable, physicalCenter). Default false.

fetchScene.description: Also return the new scene text as postScene. Default false.

text.description: Visible text of the target instead of glintId: a button label or text, exact match first, then contains. Dialogs are searched first. Several matches fail with the candidates.

awaitReady.description: Wait until the target is on screen and hittable, then act. Default false.

returnScene.description: Settle, then report changed and changeCategory. Default true.

fetchScene.description: Also return the new scene text as postScene. Default false.

glintId.description: Stable id from get_scene: pinch around its center.

text.description: Visible text of the target instead of glintId.

x.description: Center x in logical points (device mode: screenshot pixels), with y.

scale.description: How far apart the fingers end relative to where they start: 2 zooms in, 0.5 zooms out.

returnScene.description: Settle, then report changed and changeCategory. Default true.

edge.description: A system gesture from a screen edge instead of a swipe: left (back), bottom (home), bottomHold (app switcher), topLeft (Notification Center), topRight (Control Center). Physical iPhone.

fromGlintId.description: Start point — stable id from get_scene.

toGlintId.description: End point — stable id from get_scene.

awaitReady.description: Wait until fromGlintId is on screen and hittable, then act. Default false.

returnScene.description: Settle, then report changed and changeCategory. Default true.

fetchScene.description: Also return the new scene text as postScene. Default false.

fromGlintId.description: Start point — stable id from get_scene.

toGlintId.description: End point — stable id from get_scene.

awaitReady.description: Wait until fromGlintId is on screen and hittable, then act. Default false.

returnScene.description: Settle, then report changed and changeCategory. Default true.

fetchScene.description: Also return the new scene text as postScene. Default false.

direction.description: One of: up, down, left, right

amountFraction.description: Fraction of viewport to travel (0.0–1.0). Default 0.6.

returnScene.description: Settle, then report changed and changeCategory. Default true.

fetchScene.description: Also return the new scene text as postScene. Default false.

targetGlintId.description: Stable id to find. Mutually exclusive with `targetTextContent`.

targetTextContent.description: Case-insensitive substring to match against any text node's content. Useful when the compact renderer collapsed the id you wanted.

direction.description: One of: up, down, left, right. Default down.

tap.description: Tap it once found (its nearest tappable ancestor when the match is text) and return the tap result. Default false.

keyDelayMs.description: Gap between keys, 0-1000 ms. Default 18. Raise it (e.g. 80) when a formatted field (phone, card, amount) drops characters.

clear.description: Empty the focused field before typing (select-all + backspace, then a per-char backspace fallback). Default false.

focus.description: Optional glintId of an input to tap before typing.

awaitReady.description: With focus: wait until that field is hittable. Default false.

returnScene.description: Settle, then report changed and changeCategory. Default true.

detail.description: Include geometry (painted, hittable, physicalCenter). Default false.

fetchScene.description: Also return the new scene text as postScene. Default false.

key.description: One of: backspace, delete, enter, tab, escape, space, up, down, left, right, back.

modifiers.description: Held around the key: cmd, shift, ctrl, alt.

returnScene.description: Read the post-press scene for changed. Default true.

button.description: Button name. One of: home, back, lock, unlock, volumeUp, volumeDown, appSwitcher.

ceilingMs.description: Hard cap on wait time. Default 5000.

quietFrames.description: Consecutive quiet polls required to declare settled. Default 3.

checkLoadingAffordances.description: When true, frame-quiet still polls if any CircularProgressIndicator / LinearProgressIndicator / RefreshIndicator is in the scene. Default true.

text.description: Visible text to wait for, matched as tap text: does (exact, then contains).

glintId.description: Id to wait for instead of text.

gone.description: Wait until it disappears instead. Default false.

op.description: list (default) | tap | action | clear | send | answer

choice.description: answer: allow | deny, for the system prompt asking to allow notifications.

text.description: tap/action/clear: the notification whose title or body contains this.

index.description: tap/action/clear: its number in list (1 = newest).

action.description: action: the button label, e.g. Reply, Answer, Mark as read.

all.description: list: every app's notifications, not only the attached app's. Default false.

category.description: send: aps.category, which picks the app's action buttons.

data.description: send: custom keys merged into the payload beside aps.

payload.description: send: the whole APNs payload instead of title/body/category/data.

orientation.description: set: portrait | portraitUpsideDown | landscapeLeft | landscapeRight | faceUp | faceDown.

acceleration.description: set (Android emulator): [x, y, z] in m/s², Android axes.

steps.description: script: up to 30 of {orientation}, {acceleration:[x,y,z]}, {waitMs} (up to 10000) or {shake:true}.
Ordered steps, each {tool: "<name>", args: {…}} with the same args the tool takes on its own, plus app:"<name>" to run that step on another attached app. Max 20.

stopOnNoChange.description: Stop when a step reports changed:false. Default true.

returnScene.description: Append the final scene text. Default true.

steps.description: Optional steps to run while recording. Max 20.

durationMs.description: Passive capture with no steps, or the tail after them (0-30000). Default 400.

distinctOnly.description: Keep only frames that differ. Default true.

inline.description: Attach up to 4 frames as images (512 px longest side), for clients that cannot read files. Default false.

failuresOnly.description: Only entries that failed (had an errorKind).

errorsOnly.description: Only entries that look like exceptions / stack traces.

format.description: text (default, rendered) or json (structured entries — pass this to get the entries array).

native.description: Native crashes of the app since attach (iOS crash reports, Android crash buffer) instead of Dart logs.

op.description: status (default) | open | close | note | list | export

sessionId.description: Target session (optional for export; defaults to active).

key.description: Config key to set, e.g. scrollMaxScrolls (required for set; `get` lists all keys + current values).

value.description: New value for `key` (required for set). Type matches the key: int (scrollMaxScrolls), double (scrollAmountFraction), or bool.

body.description: What happened, what you expected, repro steps. Redacted before submission.

includeContext.description: Attach the recent action log (tools, targets, outcomes). Default false.

dryRun.description: Compose and return the redacted issue without filing. Use it to show the user exactly what would be posted.

op.description: status (default) | report | ship | dryRun | token_usage | audit_show | audit_verify

limit.description: For audit_show / token_usage / report: max entries to return (default 20 / 10 / 15).

sinceId.description: For token_usage / report: only count events with id > sinceId (default 0 = everything recorded).
